text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One suffered defeat in the 
Takarazuka Kinen. Even after the race, the 
first-place Tamamo Cross maintained her 
insatiable hunger for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having experienced the overwhelming power 
of the "White Lightning," Inari One burns 
with fighting spirit. She vows to achieve 
results in this race next year.
